title: Chapter 100 — The AI Roleplay Training System
intro: Scenario design, drill rotations, feedback loops, and deliberate practice.

sections.title: Practice Without Risk
sections.content:
AI roleplay lets you practice customer interactions — discovery, objection handling, closing — without risking a real sale. The AI plays the customer. You practice the 10 Steps.

The best use: practice the specific scenario you are weakest at. If you struggle with the 'I can get it cheaper online' objection, roleplay it twenty times until your response is natural. Deliberate practice improves specific skills. Random practice improves nothing.

sections.title: Coaching Rule
sections.content:
When evaluating AI training usage, ask:

Is the salesperson using AI roleplay to practice weak spots — or ignoring it?
Are they targeting specific scenarios — or practicing randomly?
Is their real-world performance improving as a result of practice?
